teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering variables and conditionals, along with lists and arrays.
Answered student questions during office hours and helped organise assignment materials and submission records.

projects.title: Task Queue
bullets: Implemented linked structures and traversal operations for an individual task queue course project using Java and Git.
Documented operation costs and boundary cases for the task queue as part of the course project.

projects.title: Study Planner Interface
bullets: Built a local browser interface with form inputs using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS as a contribution to a team project.
Documented the study planner interface and its local data flow, and tested keyboard interaction and alternate input cases.

projects.title: String Utility Library Testing
bullets: Wrote automated tests for a small string utility module in an individual course project using Java and Git.
Designed boundary and invalid-input test cases, and isolated a defect using a minimal reproducing example.
